items.title: PepGen surges on Phase 2 myotonic dystrophy clinical signal; FDA partial hold remains
items.summary: PepGen reported 46.5% mean RNA splicing correction in six treated patients in its Phase 2 DM1 10 mg/kg cohort, alongside improvements in several functional measures. Shares more than doubled intraday and ended roughly 90% higher by vendor estimates, which differ on the exact close. Small sample size, durability questions and an unresolved FDA partial hold remain material risks.

observations.value: 5 of 6 treated patients >20% correction; 4 of 6 >50%

observations.value: Video hand-opening time improved 3.9 seconds (52.7%) from baseline at Week 16

observations.value: More than doubled intraday on November 10; indicative end-of-session gain around +90%, exact close not confirmed due vendor disagreement

items.key_finding: A large clinical-data-driven repricing highlights potential DM1 efficacy, but the six-patient cohort and unresolved US regulatory hold demand caution.

items.title: CoreWeave revenue jumps 168% while interest costs overshadow operating profit
items.summary: CoreWeave reported $3.661 billion Q3 revenue, up 168% year over year, and lifted full-year guidance as its AI-cloud backlog reached $132.5 billion. Shares rose about 6% in initial after-hours reporting. However, quarterly interest expense of $846 million substantially exceeded GAAP operating income of $207 million, underscoring capital-market and execution risks.

items.title: Anthropic launches native AI work tools, increasing competitive pressure on Microsoft 365
items.summary: Anthropic launched Claude Sheets and Whiteboards in beta and made Claude Data generally available on November 10. Microsoft shares fell around 2% during the regular session as reports identified the launches as one factor, alongside hotter inflation and wider tech weakness. The products increase long-run office-software competition, but customer migration or revenue impact has not been established.

items.title: UKMTO reports new tanker strike while ADNOC confirms damage to a vessel
items.summary: UKMTO Warning 201-26 reports a tanker struck by an unknown projectile 19 nautical miles northeast of Lima, Oman, with crew safe and no reported pollution. ADNOC Logistics & Services separately confirmed attack damage to one of its vessels in UAE waters. Whether these refer to the same ship, the attacker, and any incremental oil-flow loss remain unverified.

items.title: Anthropic files IPO price range and $26 billion strategic partner placement
items.summary: Anthropic's November 10 S-1 amendment sets a proposed 825 million-share IPO at $70–$78 per share, including existing-holder shares. Seven chip and cloud partners agreed to purchase $26 billion of non-voting stock in a concurrent private placement, subject to closing conditions. The filing underscores major AI-compute financing needs while valuation and capital efficiency remain unresolved.
